DRAWING AND DOCUMENT NUMBERS:  The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

12164_(00)_P600 – Site Location Plan, 12164_(00)_P620 (Rev. P01) – Proposed Ground Floor Plan, 12164_(00)_P900 (Rev. P01) – Context Amenity Plan, Covering Letter prepared by Gerald Eve LLP (dated 10/05/2022), Marketing Report prepared by CBRE (dated 17/02/2022), Fire Safety Strategy (Revision 9) prepared by Sweco, s73 Covering Letter prepared by Colliers (dated 12/11/2025)  

REASON: To comply with Section 70(1)(a) of the Town and Country Act 1990 as amended and the Reason for Grant and also for the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
description: Variation of Condition 4 of permission ref: P2022/0933/FUL dated 16/06/2022 which sought consent for ‘change of use of 870sqm of flexible commercial (Class A1 / D1 use) floorspace at ground floor level to Class E floorspace.’ amendments seek to amend the wording of condition 4 to allow for a 24-hour office use.
